integrity: The graph structure, degrees, automorphisms and parameter recovery follow from an explicit triangular-algebra multiplication and a combinatorial proof. Finite checks are supplementary; no independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Does not cover nontrivial quandles or nonunital graph conventions; the n=2 triangular-matrix case and binary-field strata overlap prior published literature. Historical completeness of generalized triangular-algebra graph literature remains uncertain.
scientific_scope: Formal unitization of finite trivial-quandle algebras over all finite fields; loopless directed graph of nonzero zero divisors. All n>=2 and every prime power q.
title: The directed zero-divisor graph of a trivial-quandle unitization
